name: websocket-frame
description: A zero-dependency RFC 6455 WebSocket frame serializer and parser. Handles FIN, RSV bits, opcodes (text, binary, ping, pong, close), masking/unmasking, and variable length payload decoding (7-bit, 16-bit, and 64-bit lengths).
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to serialize and deserialize low-level WebSocket protocol frames for raw TCP/TLS socket connections.
